items.summary: Rewrite frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts to use jsPDF correctly: import jsPDF from 'jspdf' and import 'jspdf-autotable', create a new jsPDF instance, add a title using doc.text(), add the pioneers table using doc.autoTable() with columns for Name, Service Year, Total Hours, Average Hours, and Status, and save the file using doc.save('pioneers-report.pdf'). Remove all HTML generation and blob/anchor download logic.

Rewrite frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts to use jsPDF correctly: import jsPDF from 'jspdf' and import 'jspdf-autotable', create a new jsPDF instance, add a title using doc.text(), add the tasks table using doc.autoTable() with appropriate columns (Title, Due Date, Category, Status, Notes), and save using doc.save('tasks-report.pdf'). Remove all HTML generation and blob/anchor download logic.

Rewrite frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts to use jsPDF correctly: import jsPDF from 'jspdf' and import 'jspdf-autotable', create a new jsPDF instance, add a title using doc.text(), add the notes content using doc.autoTable() or doc.text() as appropriate, and save using doc.save('notes-report.pdf'). Remove all HTML generation and blob/anchor download logic.
